desc: ​The Inland Manufacturing AM-22 is a lightweight, monocore suppressor designed for optimal performance across various small-caliber firearms. Measuring 5.75 inches in length and just under 1 inch in diameter, this suppressor is constructed from durable aluminum, ensuring both longevity and minimal weight. Its hard-anodized finish and stainless steel base, threaded to 1/2x28 TPI, make it compatible with a range of calibers, including .22LR, .22WMR, .17HMR, and 5.7x28mm (up to 49,000 psi).​
